steps.title: What the assistant can see
steps.body: The page you have open, the records you select and any files you attach. It does not see other workspaces.

steps.title: What it can do
steps.body: Summarise pages, draft text and answer questions about your records. It asks before it changes anything.

steps.title: How to turn it off
steps.body: Use “Turn off AI” below at any time, or switch it off per app in workspace settings.
